title: Production Desk
subtitle: The first screen is not a KPI landing page. It shows the most important video output, approval gates, and delivery risk first.
bestNextDetail: Open Character Lab, attach canonical refs, then generate revise_episode markdown for the missing rights note.
noGenerationDetail: The console remains a scanner, approval, and handoff layer. Paperclip keeps execution ownership.
deploymentConstraintDetail: Serve through nginx on sfs.devscent.com with no public host ports. Use postgres14 only for metadata.
